name: Why shouldn't I try to clean up sewage myself?

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I try to clean up sewage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cleaning sewage yourself is highly risky due to the dangerous pathogens present, which can lead to serious health issues. Without proper personal protective equipment, specialized disinfectants, and professional drying techniques, you risk spreading contamination, incomplete sanitization, and potential long-term mold problems. Professionals have the training and equipment to safely and effectively handle sewage cleanup and prevent secondary damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleaning sewage yourself is dangerous due to pathogens and the risk of incomplete sanitization or mold. Professionals have the necessary training and equipment.
